spells.name: Soul Unbound
spells.description: Yone enters a spirit form for seconds, leaving his body behind for the duration and gaining % to % ramping Move Speed. When the spirit form ends, Yone snaps back to his body and repeats % of all Attack and Ability damage he dealt to champions during this time. You may Recast this ability during spirit form. Recast: End spirit form early.
spells.coverageNote: This cast has no damage-calculation effect in the current one-on-one scope.
